description:
Use this when the user asks how a stock traded around the announcement and effective dates of its entry to or exit from an index or the F&O list, alone or as a group. These are index dates, not results announcements.

Returns stock and benchmark returns in windows around those dates, volume and delivery against a baseline, and flags for other events nearby. Give `index`; add `query` (NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code) for one company, or leave it out for a group (statistics from 5 analysed events). `change_type` defaults to add; `from_date` and `to_date` bound the effective date; `benchmark` is an NSE index name (default Nifty 500); `include_flagged` false drops flagged events; `limit` is 1 to 200 (default 50).

index.description: Index id, display name or the provider's name, e.g. msci:india_standard, Nifty 50 or India Standard (case-insensitive).
index.title: Index

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_index_event_study
title: Index change event study
